PasteTooltip: Paste image from clipboard and recognize formula
QuickStartContent:
1. Enter formula code in the left LaTeX editor
2. Formula preview updates in real-time on the right
3. Use the top toolbar to quickly insert common symbols and templates
ToolbarGuideContent:
• Basic Symbols: +, -, ×, ÷, comparison symbols, etc.
• Fractions & Roots: fractions, square roots, nth roots
• Sums & Integrals: sums, integrals, limits, etc.
• Greek Letters: common Greek letters
• Brackets: various bracket types
• Matrices: 2×2 matrix, matrix with brackets, determinant
• Other: superscript, subscript, derivative, partial derivative, etc.
StyleSettingsContent:
• Formula Color: set formula display color
• Background Color: set preview area background color
• Font: choose different fonts
• Size: adjust formula size
ImageRecognitionContent:
• Click "Upload Image" to select and recognize a local image
• Click "Paste Image" or press Ctrl+V to paste an image from clipboard
ShortcutsContent:
• Ctrl + V: Paste image
• Ctrl + Z: Undo (in editor)
• Ctrl + Y: Redo (in editor)
HistoryContent:
• Click "History" button to view and reuse previous formulas
• Double-click an item in history to insert it into the editor
